title: Hallucinated Packages: Catch AI's Fake npm Imports
description:
AI just imported a package that doesn't exist! 😱

✅ Spot an import you don't recognize
✅ Run npm view to check the package name
✅ A 404 means the name is hallucinated

Day 6 of AI Debugging. Next up: Day 7, Fix a Flaky Test with AI.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to debug with AI the right way.

#shorts #coding #programming #ai #npm #javascript
comment: npm or pip: which would you check first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: before installing anything AI suggests, run npm view name. If it prints a 404, the package was made up.
